mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.class_id, a.unit_id, a.created_by, a.deadline, a.weight, a.ideal_study_time_minutes, a.created_time, a.deleted, c.name as class_name, u.name as unit_name, creator.real_name as creator_name, creator.nickname as creator_nickname FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN classes c ON a.class_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN units u ON a.unit_id = u.id LEFT JOIN users creator ON a.created_by = creator.id AND creator.deleted = 0 WHERE a.id = #{id} AND a.deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) as total_classes, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.student_id) as total_students, COUNT(a.id) as total_assignments, 0 as completed_tasks FROM classes c LEFT JOIN assignments a ON c.id = a.class_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN student_classes sc ON c.id = sc.class_id WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.deleted = 0

SELECT c.id as id, c.name as name, c.description, co.name as courseName, c.created_time FROM classes c LEFT JOIN courses co ON c.course_id = co.id AND co.deleted = 0 WHERE c.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.description, a.class_id, a.unit_id, a.created_by, a.deadline, a.created_time, c.name as class_name, creator.real_name as creator_name, creator.nickname as creator_nickname FROM assignments a LEFT JOIN classes c ON a.class_id = c.id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN users creator ON a.created_by = creator.id AND creator.deleted = 0 WHERE a.created_by = #{teacherId} AND a.deleted = 0 ORDER BY a.created_time DESC
LIMIT #{limit}
